neighbours.label: the complementizer 'that' introducing a clause after a verb or noun of thinking or reason (think that, hope that, the reason that); dropping 'that' drops the activation
fire: Honestly, I believe that she deserves the promotion more than anyone.
We all hope that the weather clears up before the wedding.
My doctor thinks that the pain will pass in a week.
I feel that we should have left much earlier.
He suspects that the letter was never sent.
Most of the team agreed that the plan was too risky.
I guess that we will find out tomorrow.
Do you really think that anyone will notice?
